title: sugestoes
description: User-submitted suggestions for the bot, created via !sugerir. _id is a numeric counter rather than an ObjectId.

channel.description: Channel where the suggestion was sent

date.description: Creation date formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (string, not BSON Date)

labels.description: Labels applied via the suggestions board (see botconfigs.suggestions.labels)
